title: Clinical coronary CT comparison finds medium-strength learned reconstruction gives the clearest plaque images
summary: In 51 patients, a paired comparison of fourteen reconstructions per coronary CT scan found that medium-strength deep learning reconstruction received the highest plaque-image quality ratings. High-strength reconstruction reduced noise most, but readers noted blurring of small plaque contours. The study tested image quality, without invasive angiography as a diagnostic reference or demonstrated clinical outcome benefit.
ai_technology: TrueFidelity deep neural network reconstruction trained on high-quality filtered-back-projection images
organization: Sapienza University of Rome; Sant’Andrea University Hospital

evidence.tested: Prospective single-center enrollment yielded 51 patients and 714 reconstructed datasets. Each acquisition was reconstructed using filtered back-projection, ten ASiR-V strengths and three learned reconstruction strengths. Two experienced radiologists, blinded to reconstruction protocol, assessed four selected reconstructions in consensus, with randomized reading order and separated sessions. Medium-strength DLIR had the highest subjective plaque-image quality; high-strength DLIR had lower noise but did not significantly outperform maximum-strength ASiR-V on the reported objective noise, SNR and CNR comparisons.
evidence.unknown: One vendor and center, selected subjective comparison datasets, consensus readers without separate-reader reproducibility, and exclusion of severe motion or high heart rates limit generalization. No invasive coronary reference was routinely available, so agreement between image reconstructions does not establish diagnostic accuracy. No radiation-dose reduction, patient outcome benefit or dedicated stent subgroup result was tested.
evidence.ai_role: The pretrained neural reconstruction selectively suppressed image noise in actual patient acquisitions, enabling the paired clinical test of image-quality and plaque-contour tradeoffs across reconstruction strengths.

source_review.scope: Read actual original cohort, neural reconstruction, paired objective/subjective evaluation and statistical Methods, corresponding Results and source limitations. Direct test refers to controlled paired clinical image-quality measurement, not prospective diagnostic outcome validation. Exact original article front DOI/title and fresh PubMed primary relationship metadata checked.
